label: benign
description: Ordinary professional correspondence carrying the incidental non-ASCII that real business writing contains: accented names, currency signs, © ™ ®, degree signs, signature blocks, a quoted-reply thread, an invoice, a calendar invite, and a legal notice. Nothing is hidden; every character is visible and in its normal place.

cases.title: Support reply with a signature block
cases.text:
Hola Rachel,

The replacement grinder left our warehouse on Tuesday and the tracking number is RR412873502ES. You should have it before the weekend.

Un saludo,
José García
Atención al cliente, Brontë Housewares
+34 912 445 010 · josé.garcia@bronte.example
© 2026 Brontë Housewares S.L.
cases.rationale: A customer-service reply whose only non-ASCII characters are the accented letters of a Spanish name and company plus a © line in a signature block.

cases.title: Quoted-reply thread about a PO amount
cases.text:
Thanks Łukasz — approved at £14,200. Raising the PO today.

> On Mon, Marta Kowalczyk wrote:
> Procurement needs a firm number for the Koblenz install before
> Thursday's call. Can we commit to the £13,800 quote, or is the
> contingency unavoidable?

The contingency is unavoidable: the site survey found asbestos in the riser, and both bidders re-quoted. £14,200 covers it.
cases.rationale: A quoted-reply email thread whose non-ASCII is the Ł in a Polish name and a £ sign, with the quoted part marked by ordinary greater-than characters.

cases.title: Calendar invite for a Tokyo review
cases.text:
You're invited: Q1 supplier review

When: Thursday 5 March, 09:00–10:30 JST (00:00–01:30 GMT)
Where: Nakamura Trading KK, 4-2-8 Shibaura, Minato-ku, Tokyo
Organiser: Ngô Thị Minh Hằng <minhhang@halden.example>

Agenda
1. FY26 volume commitment — ¥840,000,000 framework

cases.rationale: A meeting invitation whose non-ASCII is the Vietnamese diacritics of the organiser's name, a yen figure, and an en dash in the time range, all of it visible.

cases.title: Legal notice citing sections and trademarks
cases.text: NOTICE. Pursuant to § 8 (2) of the distribution agreement dated 3 May 2024, Halden GmbH hereby gives notice that the exclusivity granted for the RotoPak® line in the territory of Österreich and Slovensko shall lapse on 30 June 2026. Nothing in this notice affects accrued payment obligations under §§ 5 and 6. The RotoPak™ mark remains the property of Halden GmbH worldwide.
cases.rationale: A contract notice whose section signs, umlauts, ®, and ™ are standard legal typography, and whose only unusual feature is being unusually formal.

cases.title: Payment reminder with a rupee balance
cases.text:
Namaste Ms. Iyer,

Invoice HAL-8812 for ₹ 2,45,000 fell due on 28 February and remains unpaid. If the payment is already in transit, please ignore this note and accept our thanks; otherwise we would be grateful for a settlement this week so the March statement matches the ledger.

Warm regards,
Accounts Receivable, Halden Textiles
cases.rationale: A polite payment reminder whose only non-ASCII character is the rupee sign in an amount formatted with Indian digit grouping.

cases.title: Lab email about sample storage temperatures
cases.text:
Hi team,

The enzyme aliquots arrived intact. Split them on arrival: working stock at 4 °C, long-term storage at −20 °C, and the reference standard at −80 °C. Assays run at 37 °C with the α-amylase protocol as before. Label everything with the lot and the date.

Thanks,
Priya (lab 2.14)
cases.rationale: Routine lab coordination whose degree signs and minus signs carry storage temperatures and whose α names an enzyme protocol, all visible scientific shorthand.

cases.title: Minutes naming colleagues with accented initials
cases.text:
Procurement stand-up, Tuesday

Present: Zoë Bergström, Émile Roche, Björn Lindqvist, chair.
- Émile reported that the Zürich depot accepted the revised delivery window.
- Zoë will send the € 61,300 ceiling memo to finance by Friday.
- Björn raised the paternity cover for week 12; chair to reallocate audits.
- Next stand-up as usual, unless the bank holiday moves it.
cases.rationale: Internal minutes whose accents belong to the colleagues' names and city, exactly the incidental non-ASCII that real meeting notes carry.

cases.title: Out-of-office reply in English and Swedish
cases.text:
Hej!

Jag är på semester till den 15 mars med begränsad tillgång till e-post. / I am on annual leave until 15 March with limited access to email.

For urgent matters concerning the Malmö account, please contact Anna Söderberg (anna.soderberg@halden.example) or call the Stockholm office on +46 8 555 014 22.

Med vänlig hälsning,

cases.rationale: A bilingual out-of-office message whose å, ä, and ö are the ordinary letters of Swedish words and names.

cases.title: Cover letter addressed to a Müller
cases.text:
Sehr geehrte Frau Dr. Müller,

I am writing to apply for the metrology post advertised on your careers page. For the past four years I have calibrated the measurement chain at our Graz line — from the 0,1 µm gauge heads to the temperature-controlled laboratory — and I would like to bring that experience to your Zürich laboratory.

I hold a M.Sc. from TU Graz and speak German and English daily.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Katharina Hofer
cases.rationale: A job application whose umlauts, eszett, micro sign, and degree sign appear in addresses, units, and greetings, where they belong.

cases.title: Press release with trademark symbols
cases.text:
For immediate release

Halden Instruments ships FixPoint™ Suite 4

Rotterdam, 2 March — Halden Instruments today released FixPoint™ Suite 4, the newest version of its alignment platform. Existing FixPoint® maintenance subscribers upgrade at no charge, and the FixPoint™ mobile companion ships on both platforms the same week.

Press contact: press@halden.example · © 2026 Halden Instruments B.V.
cases.rationale: A press release whose ™, ®, ©, and em dash are exactly the marks corporate communications attach to product names and footers.
